Theme

Computing & programming

notification noun

on a phone or computer

also alert, push notification

* our formation

Cic. Fin. 5.2: tanta vīs admonitiōnis inest in locīs (Lewis & Short)

* (our own formation) admonitiō, admonitiōnis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

a reminder, a prompt

No reference work has a word for a phone’s notification. Classically admonitiō is a reminding, something that calls a matter to mind, which is what a notification does; a message itself is nūntius (see text message).

Other words

  • monitus, monitūs m. — a prompt

    noun, fourth declension · also used · modern · Traupman 262, s.v. prompt · Declension on Wiktionary

    (vōx poētica: Ov., Juv.)

    Traupman’s word for a prompt on a screen; classically a warning, in prose chiefly an omen (Lewis & Short).

See also text message, ringtone, app.

SourcesLewis & Short: admonitio · Lewis & Short: monitus

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 262.
